subtitle: Donna Elvira: recitative from Don Giovanni, Act 1

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (il scellerato; all' amor mio! with an exclamation mark).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), page 50, the recitative between No. 4 and No. 5 (10 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed page: the sung line and the continuo each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The continuo is printed on one bass staff and is written here in the piano's left hand. In bar 3 the print gives Elvira one sixteenth too many; amor's last note is read as a sixteenth so the bar adds up. The English singing translation is left out. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 73, from the median length of five recordings (Giulini 0:27, Haitink 0:33, Karajan 0:33, Nézet-Séguin 0:41, Currentzis 0:51; about half a minute).
